description_en: Call this operation to add an AI template for automated review and intelligent thumbnail tasks
description_zh: 调用本接口添加智能审核和智能封面任务需要使用的AI模板
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-ai-template --template-name AI-media-test --template-type AIMediaAudit --template-config AuditItem_:_terrorism_,_porn_,_AuditRange_:_image-cover_,_text-title_,_video_,_AuditContent_:_screen_,_AuditAutoBlock_:_yes --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAITemplate

parameters.description_en: The name of the AI template. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.
parameters.help_en: The name of the AI template. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.description_en:
The type of the AI template. Valid values:

- **AIMediaAudit**: automated review.
- **AIImage**: intelligent thumbnail.
parameters.description_zh:
AI模板类型。取值：
- **AIMediaAudit**：智能审核。
- **AIImage**：智能封面。
